messages:
jordan: FYI customer ACME (ticket #4231) reports p99 spikes and intermittent 500s on /v1/generate in us-west-2 since ~09:03. They reported latency jumps to ~1.2s and errors. Traces show a huge uptick in prefix/KV cache misses and eviction churn. Attaching quick metrics snapshot below.

mei: on it — pulling traces now. initial glance shows miss_rate ~0.68 and simultaneous high eviction_count on shard-7. pattern looks like bursty prefix entropy + header-derived key explosion.

devon: same cluster — I can repro locally with a synthetic client that sends varying X-Client-Session headers. If session id is part of cache key we explode cardinality.

jordan: logs snippet from the failing host (gpu-3):
```
[2026-07-12T09:04:12Z] route=/v1/generate latency=1189ms status=500 kv_cache.miss=true eviction=true key=prefix@app:client:abcd1234:session:xyZ
[2026-07-12T09:04:12Z] backend_call=rpc_timeout
```

samir: quick triage notes: 1) customer traffic pattern has high session churn; 2) cache key currently includes headers {X-Client-Id, X-Client-Session, Authorization(hash)}; 3) eviction policy is LRU with min_ttl=5s, eager-evict on memory_pressure. That combination explains rapid warmup + thrash.

mei: repro steps (minimal):
```bash
for i in {1..500}; do
  curl -s -H "X-Client-Session: $RANDOM-$RANDOM" -H "X-Client-Id: acme-frontend" https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' &
done
```
This recreates miss storm and p99 spike in ~20s.

devon: workaround suggestion (low risk): 1) roll config change to admin: drop X-Client-Session from cache key canonicalization; 2) bump min_ttl to 60s for prefix namespace for 15m; 3) enable hotkey splay for top-10 prefixes. Commands: 
```bash
# admin API
curl -X POST https://ops.redwood.internal/admin/cache/config -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -d '{"canonicalize_headers": ["x-client-id"], "drop_headers": ["x-client-session"], "prefix_namespaces": {"user-prefix": {"min_ttl": 60}} }'
```

ops-bot: ACTION: applied cache config change on staged hosts in us-west-2 -> dropped x-client-session from key and set min_ttl=60s for prefix namespace. Rolling to 20% traffic now. :rocket:

jordan: after 10m of rollout: p95 dropped from ~320ms to ~130ms; p99 from ~1200ms to ~310ms on the affected route. kv_cache.miss_rate down to 0.12. Customer notified and monitoring. cc @support-team

samir: good short-term win. Next steps (postmortem items):
- ship key-normalization PR to remove ephemeral headers by default (PR#7842).
- add unit tests for header canonicalization + fuzz tests for header explosion.
- revisit eviction policy: consider adaptive min_ttl based on prefix hotness.
- add alert: sudden delta>0.2 in miss_rate over 1m triggers an ops pager.

mei: I'll open the PR for canonicalization and include the repro harness. Also adding a synthetic smoke check so new sessions don't create unique keys unboundedly.

devon: let's schedule a short rollback window if the 20% rollout causes regressions. I'll prepare the terraform flag so we can toggle splay quickly.

jordan: thanks all. I'll keep ticket #4231 updated and send customer a summary. Marking this thread resolved for now but keeping an action item list for the follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
